How many entities with registration status ISSUED are registered in the jurisdiction Germany?
How many entities in the register have registration status LAPSED?
How many ISSUED entities in Luxembourg have the legal form 'Société à responsabilité limitée'?
items.sparql:
PREFIX gleif-base: <https://www.gleif.org/ontology/Base/>
PREFIX gleif-L1: <https://www.gleif.org/ontology/L1/>
PREFIX jur: <https://www.gleif.org/data/jurisdiction/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT (COUNT(?e) AS ?count)
WHERE {
  ?e gleif-base:hasRegistrationStatus gleif-L1:ISSUED .
  ?e gleif-base:hasLegalJurisdiction jur:LU .
  ?e gleif-L1:hasLegalForm ?lf .
  ?lf rdfs:label "Société à responsabilité limitée" .
}

items.question: Which three entities have the most direct consolidation subsidiaries? Give the legal name and the count.
items.sparql:
PREFIX gleif-L1: <https://www.gleif.org/ontology/L1/>
PREFIX gleif-base: <https://www.gleif.org/ontology/Base/>
PREFIX kgx: <https://example.org/gleif-kg/ontology/>

SELECT ?name (COUNT(?child) AS ?cnt)
WHERE {
  ?parent a gleif-L1:RegisteredEntity .
  ?parent gleif-L1:hasLegalName ?name .
  ?child kgx:hasDirectConsolidationParent ?parent .
}
GROUP BY ?name
ORDER BY DESC(?cnt)
LIMIT 3

items.question: Which three fund managers manage the most funds? Give the legal name and the count.

PREFIX gleif-L1: <https://www.gleif.org/ontology/L1/>
PREFIX kgx: <https://example.org/gleif-kg/ontology/>

WHERE {
  ?fund kgx:hasFundManager ?manager .
  ?manager gleif-L1:hasLegalName ?name .
}
GROUP BY ?name
ORDER BY DESC(?cnt)
LIMIT 3
